name: Brine
identity: coastal diver in a sealed copper helmet; one harpoon gun (wooden stock, gunmetal body, brass reel on the right side); an olive air pack with ONE hose to the helmet's right rear
home_region_note: Claude K's proposal on #149 (25 Oct), not yet decided by Matt; it only sets the tier material

abilities.kit: game/data/abilities/brine.json (Codex, #261); base and powered form unchanged

techniques.name: Anchor Line
techniques.binding: Reel toward an anchored heavy target
techniques.effect: He arrives with a gun-butt strike.

upgrade.name: Anchor Line II
upgrade.effect: The arrival strike staggers the target.

techniques.name: Barbed Line
techniques.binding: passive while a foe is tethered
techniques.effect: A tethered foe takes a little damage each second.

upgrade.name: Barbed Line II
upgrade.effect: Reeling a light foe into a wall stuns it.

techniques.name: Pressure Brace
techniques.effect: Pressure builds in the pack: the next harpoon flies faster and passes through one foe.

upgrade.name: Pressure Brace II
upgrade.effect: For its first 0.3 s the brace blocks from every side.
